checklist.item: Meets section 1, conditions 1 to 4, on its own mandate
checklist.note: Federal Council declaration in the 2007 report: the Perspektivstab prepares on the Council's mandate, every four years, an overview of the main future questions. The 2010 business report adds early detection of developments and trends and four future scenarios. Terms: Zukunftsszenarien, Früherkennung (scenarios, emerging change). Cross-policy. Standing: no end date seen. No written organisational regulation found; the mandate rests on Federal Council statements. Low confidence stands.

checklist.item: record 1
checklist.note: 2010 report dates the constitutive meeting of the re-formed staff (12 Nov 2009). The 2007 report (Federal Council took note 18 Apr 2007) shows the staff existed earlier, so 2009 is a reconstitution, not the earliest date. A dated official record exists either way.

checklist.item: product 0
checklist.note: Perspektiven Schweiz 2040 (Federal Council took note 19 Jun 2026, per search lead) is credited to the Bundeskanzlei with administration and science input, not to the Perspektivstab. Earlier reports 2007, 2011, 2014 are outside the window.

checklist.item: survived 1 holds on the body's own dates
checklist.note: The ruling says a council-majority change occurred in 2010. That holds only on an establishment date of 2007 (Blocher, Schmid, Couchepin, Leuenberger gone by Oct 2010). On the 2009 date used in the ruling, a majority of the Nov 2009 council had left only by Dec 2015 (Leuenberger, Merz, Calmy-Rey, Widmer-Schlumpf). The 2007 record is earlier and codebook 1.3 uses the earliest record, so 2007 applies. Perspektiven 2025 (2011) and Perspektiven 2030 (noted 17 Dec 2014) post-date Oct 2010 by more than six months. The 2015 business report still cites 'Vorgaben des Perspektivstabs'. Holds. The ruling's date basis is wrong; the code is right.

checklist.item: closedNoSuccessor 0 holds
checklist.note: No dated end found. The Chancellery runs continuous situation analysis, same branch. If an end falls in the window, the Chancellery and its section carry the mandate.

bodies.note: Unit decision and codes stand. The survival basis should cite the 2007 record (Council majority gone Oct 2010), not the 2009 reconstitution; the status 'closed' has no dated source.

The term is Lage- und Umfeldanalyse, not a listed term, but 'identify and anticipate key developments of the next 10 to 15 years' is an exploration of emerging change. Open point: the legal basis of the analysis is RVOG Art. 32, which gives it to the Chancellery. The section page assigns it to the section.

checklist.item: Fails section 1 as stated: no condition met by its own mandate
checklist.note: Eesti Arengufondi seadus (RT I 2006, 52, 385; adopted 15.11.2006, in force 01.12.2006), rendered in browser. Section 40 'Arenguseire üksus': the board forms a foresight unit as a structural unit of the Fund to organise its foresight. Section 39 defines arenguseire as systematic assessment of long-term developments in science, technology, economy, environment and society. Section 41 sets the annual plan; section 42 publicity. Section 40 shows no amendment mark, so it is the original text.

checklist.item: Condition 1
checklist.note: Section 3: the Fund is a public-law legal person created by the Act, reporting to the Riigikogu (section 4). The unit is part of it. Head appointment not checked.

checklist.item: Conditions 2 to 4
checklist.note: No end date. Named term arenguseire (foresight, development monitoring). Long-term, no stated horizon. Cross-domain.

checklist.item: Codes (B): record 1, product 0, survived 1, closedNoSuccessor 0
checklist.note: Record 1: the Act of 2006 names the unit. Product 0: the Fund and unit closed in 2016-2017. Survived 1 and successor (Arenguseire Keskus at the Riigikogu Chancellery, same legislative branch, Arenguseire Act 2016) are consistent with B but not re-sourced here.
